moisture_pct.quote: Bel Paese type cheeses have a moisture content of 44-47%, fat content of 28-29%, and a salt content of 2.3-2.5%

salt_pct.quote: Bel Paese type cheeses have a moisture content of 44-47%, fat content of 28-29%, and a salt content of 2.3-2.5%

ammonia.reason: Very low amino acid deamination/urease activity due to short 6-8 week age and no surface flora.

animal_barnyard.reason: Negligible p-cresol/indole/skatole; clean pasteurized dairy with no smear or clostridial activity.

bitter.reason: Few hydrophobic bitter peptides from limited chymosin/plasmin proteolysis and masking by salt.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation so no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone/2-undecanone beta-oxidation pathway.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose/lactose and lysine plus milk-fat browning on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate-positive Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism in young high-moisture curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low butanoic/hexanoic/octanoic acids from limited starter esterase lipolysis during short ripening.

creaminess.reason: 28-30% fat, ~49% FDM and 44-47% moisture lubricates palate with hydrated young para-casein.

crumbliness.reason: Cohesive calcium-phosphate para-casein network at pH ~5.3 gives elastic, non-granular fracture.

firmness.reason: Rennet gel at 44-47% moisture with light warming to ~38C gives elastic semi-soft body, not hard.

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine transamination by starter.

fruity.reason: Trace ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from starter esterase esterification of fatty acids with ethanol.

goaty.reason: Cow milk fat lacks caprine 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic branched-chain goaty acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Minimal Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal/2-methylpropanal from leucine/isoleucine due to low proteolysis.

melt.reason: pH ~5.3 intact hydrated casein with high moisture allows micelle flow and fat coalescence on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No surface mold; negligible 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid lipoxygenase.

oil_off.reason: Moderate emulsified fat in young protein network retains fat, limited free oil on melt.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked cheese; no guaiacol/syringol deposition from wood smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Mild L-lactic acid from mesophilic starter with little acetic/propanoic acid due to short aging.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata; no hot-water kneading and casein alignment so no fibrous stretch despite flow.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low H2S/methional/dimethyl sulfide; pasteurized milk sulfur driven off, no high cook retention.

sweet.reason: Residual galactose/lactate plus diacetyl sweet-milk perception with low acid masking.

umami.reason: Low free glutamate from limited rennet/plasmin proteolysis and ~84g/kg free amino acids max at 6 weeks.
